product_metadata.title: Angel Ornaments - Set of 3 Spun Glass Angels with Confetti Glitter Dresses - Glass Christmas Ornament Sets - Angel Figurines
features: GLASS ANGEL ORNAMENTS. This is a cute set of 3 angel ornaments that are made of a delicate spun glass. Each angel has a whimsical swirl dress made of glass tubes and colorful confetti glitter.
PRAYING ANGELS WITH GLITTER. Colorful confetti like glitter is sparkled on each angel's dress. Assorted colors of red, pink, silver, green, blue and yellow glitter.
GLASS CHRISTMAS ORNAMENTS. Give these away during the holidays to all your family and friends. They would make a great hostess gift at your next Christmas celebration.
UNIQUE GLASS ORNAMENTS. Nice boxed ornament sets for Christmas. The whimsical design of these angels are a cool addition
BANBERRY DESIGNS angels measures approx. 2 1/4" H and 1" W.
description: Banberry Designs original spun glass ornament sets are the perfect addition to your holiday ornaments. This set of 3 sparkling angels comes in a gift box. Each angel has a swirly dress made of glass tubes and adored with colorful “fun” glitter. The angels measure approx. 2 ¼”H X 1” W. They come with a silver cord for hanging, or these can be displayed on a tabletop or shelf.
